shortDescription: Runs migration scripts against a database

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: Database server connection timeout in seconds. Only affects connection attempts. Does not affect execution timeout.

options.name: create_database
options.description: Will create an empty database if missing.

options.name: deployment_method
options.description: C(SingleTransaction) - wrap all the deployment scripts into a single transaction and rollback whole deployment on error. C(TransactionPerScript) - wrap each script into a separate transaction; rollback single script deployment in case of error. C(NoTransaction) - deploy as is. C(AlwaysRollback) - roll back the transaction.

options.name: execution_timeout
options.description: Script execution timeout. The script will be aborted if the execution takes more than specified number of seconds.

options.name: match
options.description: Runs a regex verification against provided file names using the provided string.

options.name: no_log_version
options.description: If set, the deployment will not be tracked in the database. That will also mean that all the scripts and all the builds from the package are going to be deployed regardless of any previous deployment history.

options.name: no_recurse
options.description: Only process the first level of the target path.

options.name: path
options.description: Directory where targeted sql scripts are stored.

options.name: schema_version_table
options.description: A table that will hold the history of script execution. This table is used to choose what scripts are going to be run during the deployment, preventing the scripts from being execured twice.

options.name: sql_instance
options.description: The SQL Server instance to modify.
